actions.action: Separate naming directions from wording variants
actions.mechanism: Organize suggestions by their stated rationale and addressed constraints, not just textual similarity or early attention.
actions.implementation: Add rationale and constraint fields. Let contributors create direction lanes and place a suggestion in multiple lanes without duplicating it.
actions.check: Submit “Oak Commons” for tree identity and “Oak Common” for shared stewardship; verify both directions remain visible.
actions.risk: Mandatory categorization could discourage tentative ideas; allow unclassified submissions.

actions.action: Reopen rejections when their constraints change
actions.mechanism: Bind each rejection to explicit, versioned constraints so its applicability can be checked after edits.
actions.implementation: Store rejection explanations with constraint versions. When a referenced constraint changes, mark the rejection “needs reconsideration” and notify reviewers without automatically accepting the name.
actions.check: Reject a name for exceeding two words; relax that limit and verify the rejection becomes reviewable with its original explanation intact.
actions.risk: Broad constraint edits may generate excessive reconsideration notices.

actions.action: Show hard-constraint conflicts independently of popularity
actions.mechanism: Keep hard-constraint violations visible without selecting a winner or suppressing the violating suggestion.
actions.implementation: Give constraints hard or advisory status. Attach pass, fail, or unknown assessments with evidence to names; retain contested assessments and record constraint edits.
actions.check: Give a popular name three words under a two-word hard limit; verify its conflict remains visible despite support.
actions.risk: Subjective constraints need human assessment rather than automatic failure.

actions.action: Protect authorship during anonymous first review
actions.mechanism: Separate private attribution records from review content and withhold identity until each reviewer submits their first assessment.
actions.implementation: Store author IDs behind restricted access. Serve anonymous review payloads without author metadata, avatars, or attribution history; make later disclosure explicit.
actions.check: Inspect first-review responses and exports for identity leaks; verify authorized custodians can still recover original authorship.
actions.risk: Distinctive rationale wording may reveal identity despite metadata protection.

actions.action: Give late alternatives a fresh-review queue
actions.mechanism: Allocate attention by review coverage rather than popularity, ensuring late suggestions receive an independent reading.
actions.implementation: Maintain an explicit unreviewed queue with round-robin presentation. Hide support totals during first review; require a linked earlier suggestion and rationale comparison for “already considered.”
actions.check: Add a late, similar-sounding name addressing a new constraint; verify it enters review and cannot be dismissed with an unlinked duplicate label.
actions.risk: Queue obligations may slow large sessions; permit visible deferral.

actions.action: Make every grouping reversible and traceable
actions.mechanism: Treat groups as references to intact suggestions rather than replacements that erase distinctions or attribution.
actions.implementation: Preserve immutable submission records and edit history. Record group membership changes; provide expandable originals and undoable split operations, respecting private-authorship permissions.
actions.check: Group two similar names, edit the group label, then split it; verify original wording, rationales, IDs, and authorized authorship remain recoverable.
actions.risk: Large histories can clutter the interface; collapse them by default.

actions.action: Keep unresolved dissent beside team shortlists
actions.mechanism: Preserve objections as structured open issues rather than letting a shortlist imply unanimous agreement.
actions.implementation: Attach objections to names or directions with the disputed constraint, explanation, and resolution status. Show unresolved issues beside shortlists; require recorded reasons for closure and allow reopening.
actions.check: Shortlist a popular name with an unresolved hard-constraint objection; verify the objection stays visible and closure preserves its history.
actions.risk: Repeated objections can overwhelm discussion; link duplicates without deleting originals.
